Uber is one of the widely used ride booking platforms in India and it offers multiple travelling options to users such as bikes,autos,parcel services and various cab categories. It makes travelling easier for everything from daily commutes to airport transfers,office rides,long distance outstation trips with quick bookings & real-time tracking

Uber India is giving various ride options that cater to different budgets and traveling needs. Users have plenty of options like Uber go for everyday commutes to sedan rides and large vehicles like Uber XL for group travels. Across several cities, Uber Auto serves as a convenient option for quick, short-distance travel, while premium ride choices are suited for those who prefer a more comfortable and upgraded experience.

Managing travel expenses or giving everyday convenience becomes simple with an Uber Gift Card. It can be used for a variety of needs, from daily commutes and office rides to airport transfers and late-night trips, eliminating the hassle of carrying cash or using cards for every ride. Once added to the Uber app, the gift card balance can be used across different ride options such as bikes, autos, and cabs, based on availability in your city.

What can I purchase with my Adani Meet & Greet Gift Cards?
Adani Meet & Greet Gift Cards can be redeemed to purchase the Adani Meet & Greet packages, giving you access to premium airport services on arrival and departure of their national and international flights.
Can I send an Adani Meet & Greet Gift Card to someone else?
Yes, you can send Adani Meet & Greet Gift Cards from GyFTR to your loved ones using the ‘I am Gyfting’ option.
How to send Adani Meet & Greet Gift Cards to someone else?
Send Adani Meet & Greet Gift Card by following these steps:
Choose the desired denomination you want to send.
Press the “I am Gyfting” checkbox.
Enter the details of the recipient and choose a message to make it more personalized.
Press the “Checkout” button and complete the transaction using the available payment modes.
What are the available denominations of Adani Meet & Greet Gift Cards?
On GyFTR, you will find Adani Meet & Greet Gift Cards in various denominations that suit your purchase requirements. The denominations of Gift Cards are subject to change based on availability.
How many times can an Adani Meet & Greet Gift Card be used?
Visit Adanione.com, go to Pranaam Services, and enter your flight details to view available packages at select Adani airports.
Choose a suitable package and proceed.
Enter your details, apply your gift card under "Apply Coupon Code", and complete the payment after the discount is applied.
Where can I use the Adani Meet & Greet Gift Card?
This Gift Card is only accepted at the Adani One app or the official website.
What if my Adani Meet & Greet Gift Card expires?
GyFTR advises redeeming your Adani Meet & Greet Gift Card before the validity date. The Gift Card shall be invalid after the date mentioned in the details received with the Gift Card via SMS/Email/WhatsApp.
What happens if I lose my Adani Meet & Greet Gift Card?
To recover your Adani Meet & Greet Gift Card, visit https://www.gvhelpdesk.com/ & use the ‘I WANT TO RESEND MY VOUCHER’ section of this page.
